// A sequence of keys over one value, with extrapolation policies before the
// first key and after the last. Keys are ordered by ascending Time.
type AnimationTrack<T>
    implements ITimeVarying<T>
{
    Keys: Array<Keyframe<T>>;
    Before: Extrapolation;
    After: Extrapolation;
}
